html:
Could start creating a "madlibs" style structure to brainstorm potential outcomes: 

Answer the following questions with several examples (rooted in the evidence you've collected)

What? 

  • App
  • Mag-safe attachment
  • Separate device, micro gadget
  • Wearable

Who

  • Gen Z, High school students, 1st or 2nd year college student
  • people who struggle with compulsive behaviors

Where

  • Showering
  • Sleep routine / sleep hygiene / "bed-rotting"
  • Walking
  • Commute
  • Repetitive tasks
  • School - Lunchroom, Hallway, (talk to Noelle)

How

  • speed-bumps (interruption)
  • prohibition (screen time restrictors)
  • punishment (i.e. Pavlok)
